🎯 TECHNICAL ANALYSIS: Support & Resistance Zones

Support and resistance are price levels where buying or selling pressure historically concentrates. Think of them as psychological battlegrounds between bulls and bears.

SUPPORT is where price tends to find buying interest and bounce higher. RESISTANCE is where selling pressure emerges and price struggles to break through.

Real Market Example:
EURUSD has tested 1.0800 three times since June 2026 without breaking below. That level becomes strong support. Smart traders watch for entries near 1.0805 with stops below 1.0790.

How to identify quality zones:

- Look for multiple touches: 3+ tests makes a zone reliable
- Higher timeframes matter more: Daily levels beat 5-minute levels
- Volume confirms strength: Big moves away from zones show conviction
- Round numbers attract attention: 1.1000, 1.2500, etc.

Trading the zones:

- Buy near support with stops below it
- Sell near resistance with stops above it
- When broken, old support becomes new resistance and vice versa

PRO TIP: The longer price stays away from a zone, the stronger it becomes when retested. A support level untouched for 3 months carries more weight than one tested yesterday.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💰 FUNDAMENTAL FOCUS: Interest Rates & The Fed

Interest rates are the price of money. When the Federal Reserve adjusts rates, global markets react instantly.

Higher rates make the dollar more attractive to foreign investors seeking yield. Lower rates weaken the dollar but stimulate economic growth and risk assets.

Current Market Context August 2026:
The Fed has maintained rates at 4.50-4.75% for five consecutive meetings. Markets are pricing in potential cuts by Q4 2026 as inflation pressures ease.

Key Fed Signals to Watch:

- FOMC statements: Hawkish means rates stay high, dovish hints at cuts
- Chair Powell speeches: Markets move on single words
- Employment data: Strong jobs support higher rates
- CPI releases: Inflation above 3% keeps Fed cautious

Real Trading Impact:

When Fed hints at rate cuts, expect USD weakness and stock market strength. When inflation data surprises high, yields spike and risk assets sell off.

Example: July 2026 CPI came in at 2.8% vs 3.1% expected. USD dropped 80 pips across majors within 30 minutes.

SMART MONEY RULE: Don't fight the Fed. Trading against central bank policy is expensive. Align your positions with the interest rate trend.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚡ 3 DAILY TRADING TIPS - Tuesday 04 August 2026

TIP 1: Watch Early London Session Volatility
European session opens with fresh liquidity. Major pairs often set daily range between 0800-1000 GMT. Avoid chasing breakouts in the first 30 minutes. Let the dust settle.

TIP 2: Use Multiple Timeframe Confirmation
Before entering any trade, check alignment across 3 timeframes. Daily for trend, 4H for structure, 1H for entry. All three should agree. No agreement means no trade.

TIP 3: Trade the Setup Not the Outcome
Your job is executing quality setups with proper risk management. Market decides outcomes. Focus on process over profits. Five perfect setups with two losses still means you did your job correctly.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🛡️ RISK MANAGEMENT: Capital Preservation First

Protecting capital matters more than making profits. You can't trade without capital. Every professional trader prioritizes survival over success.

The 2% Rule:
Never risk more than 2% of total account on a single trade. With a 10,000 USD account, maximum risk is 200 USD per position. This lets you survive 20 consecutive losses.

Position Sizing Formula:
Risk Amount divided by Stop Loss Distance equals Position Size. If risking 200 USD with 50 pip stop, you can trade 4 mini lots maximum.

Daily Loss Limits:
Stop trading after losing 6% of account value in one day. Emotional trading after big losses destroys accounts. Walk away, reset, return tomorrow.

Why This Matters:
August 2026 markets remain choppy with Fed uncertainty. Protecting capital during unclear conditions lets you deploy aggressively when clarity returns.

PROFESSIONAL TRUTH: The traders still active after 5 years aren't the most profitable. They're the ones who never blew up their accounts. Defense wins championships.
